studies.title: Ricci's map of the world
studies.caption: The Jesuit Matteo Ricci and the scholar Li Zhizao print a great map of the world in Chinese, with China near the centre and the continents and seas of the European map named in Chinese.
studies.prompt: Interior Beijing study around1602: a large oval world map on SIX adjacent vertical paper panels, mounted on a plain wall, with the Pacific near centre and Asia toward centre-left and the Americas toward centre-right. A Chinese scholar in Ming clothing and a bearded European scholar in Chinese-style robe study it from side in three-quarter rear view. Map and exchange of knowledge dominate, little text-like ink marks not readable Chinese. No Qing queue, no modern map colours, no modern borders or modern furniture.
